name: Shabana Mahmood
role: UK Home Secretary (2025–present); Labour MP for Birmingham Ladywood since 2010; former Justice Secretary and Lord Chancellor
summary: As Home Secretary, Mahmood introduced tighter settlement rules and advocated controlled immigration and integration. She voted to renew the UK nuclear deterrent and against legalising assisted dying, and she has advocated a two-state settlement for Israel and Palestine.
